original_test_intent: Validate each Type 39 Asset Tag Number against the owner asset inventory, including explicitly valid untagged states, without confusing it with serial/model/name, and confirm persistence after reboot.
original_method: Resolve every Asset Tag string index, bind its exact controlled value or approved empty state to a stable PSU identity, compare with the asset register and repeat after approved reboot.
manual_activity: A user supplies the asset register, empty/privacy rules and reboot approval; the core field validation remains automated and read-only.
required_inputs: Expected asset tag per supply or approved untagged state
Asset tag normalization, duplicate, privacy and retention policy
Stable PSU identity map and read-only asset/FRU inventory
SMBIOS parser and approved reboot/OOB plan
safety_requirements: Do not substitute Serial Number, Device Name or Model Part Number for an absent asset tag.
Protect asset identifiers and validate raw string references before redaction.
Never manipulate a PSU to establish a tag.
Stop on power/management degradation; no automatic reboot retry.
agent_execution_scope: Validate every Asset Tag index and exact value, apply approved untagged/privacy rules, bind to asset inventory and diff across reboot.
Report dangling, unauthorized blank, duplicate, mismatched or changing tags without issuing PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve the asset-tag register, allowed untagged states, privacy controls and reboot plan.
Adjudicate inventory exceptions and issue the verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The label is relevant, but grep cannot prove raw reference, owning supply, asset semantics or approved blank state.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Archive controlled raw/decoded Type 39 and emit identity/index/exact-or-redacted-tag/untagged-policy/inventory-match rows before and after reboot.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Asset Tag Number scope, Type 39 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Range-check and resolve each Asset Tag reference, distinguish explicit untagged states from errors, compare within the approved asset register and repeat after reboot.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, BIOS/BMC, parser/dmidecode and asset-inventory versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 39 Asset Tag Number definition plus organizational asset policy.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds raw reference integrity, field-semantic separation, controlled inventory comparison and empty-state policy.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Detects wrong identity-field substitutions, invalid blanks, duplicates and reboot drift.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Authoritative asset register and untagged/privacy policy.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A legitimately untagged replaceable PSU may have an empty string; absence is judged only by the supplied policy.

project_override_considerations: Projects may allow blank asset tags or protected representations, but must record that policy and must not substitute another identity field.
expected_evidence: Approved asset-tag map, untagged and privacy policy
Pre-reboot Type 39 handles, raw indices and controlled exact/resolved tag evidence
Per-supply asset-register comparison with duplicate/blank decisions
Statement that no PSU was manipulated
Approved reboot/health record and post-reboot diff

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Asset Tag Number is a valid Type 39 string field; allowed empty values are project policy.

blocked_analysis.analysis: String and asset-inventory comparison are automatable after approved inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds string integrity, asset-field separation, identity mapping and controlled empty/privacy handling.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains its evidence and safety while restoring FULLY AUTOMATABLE capability.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Treats missing asset data as readiness, not a permanent block or partial core.

review_improvement: Prevents accepting a serial/model as an asset tag and distinguishes intentional untagged inventory from malformed firmware metadata.
independent_technical_reasoning: An asset tag is an administrative identifier with platform-specific optionality; correctness needs field identity, an explicit empty policy and a stable asset-register relation.
